findings.title: Defer dynamic imports until the app is requested
findings.body: Each import() is invoked while the appStore object is constructed, so importing this registry still starts loading and evaluating every app, even when a request only needs one calendar or payment provider. This does not provide on-demand loading and retains the startup work this change is intended to avoid. Store loader functions instead, and invoke only the selected loader at each consumer.

findings.title: Await the asynchronous reschedule cleanup callbacks
findings.body: The new async forEach callback returns a promise that forEach discards. In particular, failures from the now-asynchronous getCalendar call (including CalendarService constructor failures) no longer reach the surrounding try/catch and become unhandled rejections. Reschedule can report success without handling those failures. Await a Promise.all over mapped callbacks, or use an awaited loop, so cleanup errors reach the logger. The same newly introduced callback change exists in packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts.
